# Deployment Status

## Public production exists and is live

Verified public HTTPS routes on 2026-09-11:
- `https://awtsmoos.com/`
- `https://awtsmoos.com/apps/`
- `https://awtsmoos.com/games/`
- `https://awtsmoos.com/apps/transcribe/`

These routes return public content and are independently visible outside the local tunnel.

## Canonical production mechanism

The repository's GitHub Actions workflow deploys pushes to `main` to the Hetzner production checkout at `/mnt/HC_Volume_102267213/git/awtsmoos.com`. Production fetches `origin/main`, verifies the pushed SHA, hard-resets to that exact SHA, cleans untracked files, activates the canonical server, and executes public release verification scripts.

This means production is intentionally SHA-locked and should never be updated by copying random files from a dirty development checkout.

## Current local release safety

Current local branch: `main`.
Remote: `origin https://github.com/awtsmoos/awtsmoos.com.git`.

At the release audit:
- local committed HEAD: `7969a3063f8f4520989c3fde5b46e3482c48b3d5`
- `origin/main`: `4c0667bc877e4d47d8f875397e4d7e1dab6ee962`
- local committed history: 3 commits ahead and 26 commits behind remote
- working tree: 1,510 dirty paths

The dirty paths include large unrelated concurrent work across AI relay, social, server, emulator, apps, workflows, and other systems. A wholesale commit/push would therefore risk deploying unrelated unfinished changes.

## Hardened local graph versus origin/main

Many audited hardening files are absent from `origin/main`, including shared commerce focus/surface modules, mobile sheet modules/tests, Radiance copy/catalog tests, reconciliation health modules/route/tests, and route-only product-memory modules. Several integration files are modified relative to remote.

A tracked-area comparison alone found 48 relevant tracked deltas, but that number is not a safe release manifest because many essential local modules are untracked/new and therefore absent from ordinary `git diff --name-only` output.

## Deployment decision

Do NOT push the current checkout wholesale.

The safe promotion path is:
1. create a fresh worktree from current `origin/main`;
2. build a complete dependency-closed release manifest including new/untracked modules;
3. overlay only that coherent Geelooy release graph;
4. run the same complete platform tests plus repository quality gates in that clean worktree;
5. review the resulting diff for unrelated regressions;
6. commit/push only that isolated release SHA to `main`;
7. let the canonical GitHub→Hetzner workflow deploy and verify it.

Until that clean release candidate is proven, the public Awtsmoos.com deployment is live, but exact parity with every newest local hardening file is intentionally NOT claimed.
